response.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CASE WHEN res.laps IS NULL OR TRIM(res.laps) IN ('', '\N') THEN NULL ELSE CAST(res.laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder > 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY average_laps IS NULL, average_laps DESC, r.raceId LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Missing laps are represented by NULL, an empty string, or '\N'.
